v0.description: The original default recommended SLURM configuration set on the AIND ephys pipeline repo.

v1.description: Revised configuration to decrease memory and CPU requests in hopes of faster priorities in SLURM queue.

v2.description: Revised configuration to increase memory limits for job_dispatch and preprocessing.

v3.description: Revised configuration to double the memory limit for preprocessing, from 128 GB to 256 GB. Hopefully temporary, until a pipeline release ships a SpikeInterface version (0.105.0 or later) with online batching for DREDge motion estimation.
